scope: Public-source design validation. Runtime sandbox tests are recorded separately in SAP_LIVE_CASE_REFERENCE_V1_2.json. No real passenger, ticket or payment data is used.

sources.title: Air New Zealand: Manage your flight bookings
findings: Bookings made through a travel agent or another airline are directed to that booking provider.
Fare type and route affect cancellation and refund conditions.
Air New Zealand booking references have six alphanumeric characters and end in H.
sources.app_implication: Keep the travel-agent branch, six-character synthetic references ending in H, and human review of rules. These public statements do not establish a particular passenger's refund entitlement.

sources.title: Air New Zealand: Credits and refunds
findings: Direct and travel-partner bookings have different credit-management channels.
Credit availability depends on circumstances and applicable booking conditions.
sources.app_implication: Do not automatically equate a disruption, a credit memo request, a travel credit or a payment refund.

sources.title: SAP Business Accelerator Hub: Credit Memo Request (A2X)
sources.verified: Earlier personal-account API inspection and recorded sandbox GET evidence
sources.app_implication: Use only the actual read-only OData v4 response as a generic financial reference. Preserve raw status codes and currency; do not infer airline booking linkage, verified payment, refundable amount, approval or completed payment.

sources.title: OpenCode CLI: Export
findings: The documented CLI export operation exports a session as JSON.
sources.app_implication: Retain real native OpenCode session exports and a separately checked runnable source ZIP. Do not describe locally packaged source as a verified native App ZIP export operation.

test_data_classification.journeys_and_cases: Synthetic local fixtures and test-only example.com contacts
test_data_classification.financial_record: SAP public sandbox sample 60000002, fetched with the authorized personal API Hub key on the server
test_data_classification.negative_lookup: Unknown numeric sandbox document 9999999999; failure must not create a snapshot or case event
test_data_classification.excluded: Production passenger records, real payment evidence, classroom account configuration, SAP write operations and model transmission of secrets

limitations: Public policy guidance is context, not a live eligibility engine or a substitute for authoritative ticket and payment records.
The generic SAP USD net amount is not reconciled to the synthetic NZD journey fare.
The selected API partially fits the A2 refund-case preparation proposal; actual airline reconciliation remains outside the prototype.
